anomalies.description: A rooster is being forced to fight in a confined arena while surrounded by spectators; the setting and context suggest organized animal combat, constituting abuse of a helpless victim.
Two roosters are engaged in a physical fight inside a chalk-drawn square on the ground, with one actively pecking and striking the other.

A man in a black tank top is engaged in a physical altercation with multiple individuals in a crowded outdoor setting; he is seen shouting, pushing, and being restrained or grappled by others, including a bald man with glasses and several men wearing cowboy hats.

The same man in the black tank top breaks free from the crowd and runs toward a parked car, while another man (bald, glasses) pursues him and appears to grab or strike him near the vehicle, indicating continuation of the physical conflict.
The red car makes contact with the rear/side of the silver/white car, causing visible dust displacement and vehicle deformation consistent with a collision during high-speed pursuit.

A person in the red car is visibly holding and firing a firearm toward the right side of the frame, with muzzle flash implied by the posture and context of the chase; the gun is raised and aimed during the final frame (f15).
A person in the driver's seat of the red car is visibly aiming and firing a handgun out the window toward the silver/white car ahead.
